rules: World depth profile is authoritative for physics, geography, culture/settlement context and temporal state.
Weather/event state changes presentation without regenerating geography.
Unknown continents, cities, atmospheric colors or orbital objects are not invented as canon.
Settlement architecture requires culture/organization/era context in addition to planetary environment.

visual_identity_anchors: recognizable real-Earth geography when specific location is known
Trek-era infrastructure overlays real geography rather than replacing planet with generic megacity
civilization_rules: San Francisco/Marin Starfleet/Federation areas use dated institutional architecture
other regions retain regional identity
global Human culture is not visually homogenized
forbidden: random giant orbital structures without facility state

visual_identity_anchors: red/brown/orange rock and desert families where references support
civilization_rules: Vulcan architecture must be sourced/era-aware
settlements should respond to heat/aridity rather than generic desert fantasy
forbidden: mystical glow because culture is logical/telepathic
unknowns: exact sky/atmospheric color outside sourced scenes

visual_identity_anchors: ringed gas giant may dominate sky only from physically valid views
civilization_rules: Andorian and Aenar spaces may differ; do not visually collapse them
underground infrastructure should read as adapted to extreme cold/geothermal energy
forbidden: Andoria rendered as ordinary Earth alpine world
gas giant inserted in every shot regardless of camera/location

visual_identity_anchors: healing bog/wetland regions only where resolved
61 Cygni stellar context must not become decorative dual-sun fantasy without actual lighting model
civilization_rules: Tellarite settlements require separate architectural references
debate culture has no environmental visual shorthand

visual_identity_anchors: First City/Great Hall contexts only when location is specified
civilization_rules: Klingon urban/civic architecture must distinguish government, House and military contexts
world is a civilization center, not a permanent battlefield

visual_identity_anchors: Romulus and Remus are separate sister worlds
urban/government scenes use Romulan institutional language appropriate to era
civilization_rules: military/Tal Shiar styling does not define all civilian architecture
political/security spaces may be more formal/controlled than domestic spaces
forbidden: all-green environment because Romulan UI uses green

visual_identity_anchors: warm/humid environmental preference informs inhabited interiors
Cardassian monumental/institutional urban language where sourced
civilization_rules: government/military/intelligence/civil spaces resolve separately
urban damage depends on campaign/date
forbidden: planet permanently dim because Cardassians prefer dimmer interiors

visual_identity_anchors: Bajoran natural/cultural regions vary; no single biome default
system context may include moons/Denorios Belt/wormhole only when composition is physically relevant
civilization_rules: surface architecture remains Bajoran
Cardassian occupation remnants/reconstruction appear only where history/location supports
DS9 is a separate facility asset
forbidden: DS9 architecture pasted onto Bajor cities

civilization_rules: commercial density/branding derives from actual district/business state
wealth differences may affect materials but not species caricature
forbidden: dry sunny default without exceptional state

visual_identity_anchors: Mak'ala pools/caves are distinct ecological-cultural location
symbiont pools are biological, not magical
civilization_rules: Symbiosis Commission and civic spaces are institutional, not all sacred
joined/unjoined status is not visible in city design
forbidden: every Trill scene centered on joining

visual_identity_anchors: Federation-member civic context in late playable eras
civilization_rules: Betazoid architecture requires actual local/institutional reference
telepathic culture does not create visible psychic infrastructure by default
forbidden: generic paradise imagery in every region
Dominion occupation visuals unless date/campaign state says so
